h10.

**`(*renderer).addArg` — `internal/filter/render.go:842` — approximately 28 call sites**

`addArg` is the argument-binding helper for the CEL-to-SQL filter renderer: it appends a value to the renderer's argument list and returns the dialect-appropriate placeholder, so essentially every branch that emits a SQL fragment with a bound parameter calls it. All 28 calls live in the single file that declares it, `internal/filter/render.go` — the other files in `internal/filter` (`engine.go`, `helpers.go`, `ir.go`, `parser.go`, `schema.go`) contain zero. Some lines pair two calls in one statement, for example the exact-match/prefix-match pairs around lines 454-467. No test file calls it, so the count is the same with or without tests.

How it compares to the runners-up, all also in `internal/filter`:

| Symbol | Path | Approx. callers |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `(*renderer).addArg` | `internal/filter/render.go:842` | 28 |
| `Schema.Field` | `internal/filter/schema.go:67` | 19 |
| `jsonArrayExpr` | `internal/filter/render.go:944` | 16 |
| `(*MarkdownRenderer).renderChildren` | `internal/markdown/renderer/markdown_renderer.go:170` | 14 |
| `getConstValue` | `internal/filter/parser.go:465` | 13 |

Two clarifications about scope. I counted unexported symbols as well as exported ones, since the question asks about any function or method declared under `internal/`; the winner is unexported, so all its fan-in is necessarily intra-package. If you restrict to symbols callable from outside `internal/`, the picture changes entirely and the leader is `util.GenUUID` (`internal/util`) with 7 production call sites — in `server/auth/token.go:194`, `server/router/api/v1/auth_service_session.go:26` and `:135`, `attachment_service_storage.go:209`, `user_service_access_tokens.go:84`, `shortcut_service.go:154`, and `sso_username.go:15` — rising to roughly 28 references once test files are included. Close behind are `filter.DefaultEngine` (7 callers, in the three DB drivers' `memo.go`/`memo_relation.go` plus `shortcut_service.go:341`) and `filter.AppendConditions` (6), which is a fan-in pattern driven by the schema having three parallel SQL dialect implementations.

These are call-site counts from textual matching rather than a type-resolved call graph, so treat them as approximate; the gap between 28 and 19 is comfortably wide enough that the ranking holds.
